key_difference: (D) implements clearLocalData() as an unguarded inline d.set(nullptr), so it can re-create thread-local storage during shutdown; it leaves the QThreadData::currentThreadData() guard (and the qthread_p.h include) in the qcollator caller and only documents the hazard. (B) adds an exported QThreadStorageData::clear() that does the guarding itself, making clearLocalData() unconditionally shutdown-safe.
